    Healthcare Decision Intelligence is a free eBook series helping analysts, clinicians, managers and decision-makers to interpret, question and use healthcare data responsibly. This ebook covers 21 modules (at the time of writing, with one marked as coming soon) on how to make better decisions with data.

> The series is designed to support:
>
> - analysts
> - operational leaders
> - clinicians
> - managers
> - decision-makers
>
> in developing a stronger understanding of:
>
> - healthcare metrics
> - variation
> - benchmarking
> - inequalities
> - operational performance
> - population health
> - analytical fairness and interpretation"

The ebook is accompanied by a [companion app](https://decisionintelligence-healthcare.streamlit.app) to support readers in finding the most relevant content for their particular question or area of interest.
